# False-positive disk alerts from a bind-mounted filesystem

A disk-usage alert fires nightly but the disk is not actually full when checked.

The disk alert did not exclude pseudo/bind-mounted filesystems, so node_exporter reported 100% on read-only pseudo mounts that are always 'full', creating nightly false positives.

1. Identify which filesystem the alert matches (a pseudo/bind mount)
2. Add fstype and mountpoint exclusions to the node_exporter collector
3. Update the alert query to filter real filesystems only
4. Confirm the alert no longer fires overnight

Error Details
```
Alert 'DiskSpaceLow' filesystem=/proc/... usage=100%; node_exporter reporting pseudo-filesystems; label mountpoint duplicated via bind mount
```

Tags: monitoring, false-positive, node-exporter, disk, bind-mount
